review_scope: Partial review: Alberta, Quebec and CanadaBuys landing pages checked without record-level revisions verified. items.headline: New quarterly vacancy and offered-wage release available for review
items.observed_change: The official table page lists a September 15, 2026 release and links to second-quarter 2026 job-vacancy analysis. This confirms release availability only; province-trade values and historical revisions have not been reconciled in this review.
items.model_implication: Review the new vintage with existing occupation mappings, units and suppression flags before updating labour indicators. Offered wages and vacancies are labour-market context, not realized data-centre construction labour hours. Ontario and BC inventory retrieval gaps remain; this edition is a partial review.

retrieval_evidence.archive_storage: Local raw archive; retrieval manifest committed. No normalization or model promotion.

items.headline: AESO changes its connection-dashboard link
items.observed_change: The September 21 archived page replaces the Connection Project List Dashboard portal link with a Power BI viewer link relative to September 14. Phase 1 quantities remain 1,200 MW, comprising 970 MW GLDC and 230 MW Keephills. No additional realized capacity or construction activity is inferred from the link change.
items.model_implication: Check compatibility of future dashboard retrievals. Keep power quantities and acquisition-queue eligibility unchanged; a connection-dashboard link does not satisfy treatment or outcome gates.
